updates.note: Management reaffirmed the EBITDA margin range of 19%-21% for the year.
updates.quote: our EBITDA margins remained healthy and within our planned range of 19%-21%.

updates.note: Management stated guidance for full-year volume growth remains intact.
updates.quote: our guidance for the full financial year remains intact, and the targets that we are gunning for internally remains intact as well.

new_promises.statement: We plan to add 8,000 to 10,000 outlets to our overall network by the end of this financial year.
new_promises.quote: I think we will look to add anywhere between 8,000 to 10,000 outlets to our overall network by the end of this financial year.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra
